summary: Practise workout loss calculations, downturn LGD analysis and model validation. Explore the five-day course and its applied curriculum.
lede: Loss given default (LGD) estimates the economic loss on a credit exposure after default by linking recoveries, collateral proceeds, costs and timing. For credit risk analysts, model developers and validators, the work involves reconciling workout data, calculating discounted losses and assessing recovery patterns; training covers segmentation, downturn estimates, back-testing and ongoing model monitoring.
audienceIntro: If your work involves measuring credit losses after default, this course is designed for you. It suits intermediate practitioners who prepare, estimate, challenge or use recovery and workout evidence.
audience: Credit Portfolio Managers using LGD trends
modules: Workout Cash Flows and Economic Loss
prerequisites: Working knowledge of credit risk, default events and recovery or collateral data is recommended. No coding is required; exercises use spreadsheet calculations and model documentation workflows.
